description: Search resources and repository content within one GitLab project.

author_username.description: Filter by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items scopes with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.
author_username.title: Author Username

confidential.description: Filter by confidentiality for issues and work_items scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.
confidential.title: Confidential

exclude_author_username.description: Exclude results by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.
exclude_author_username.title: Exclude Author Username

exclude_source_branch.description: Exclude merge requests with this source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.
exclude_source_branch.title: Exclude Source Branch

exclude_target_branch.description: Exclude merge requests with this target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.
exclude_target_branch.title: Exclude Target Branch

fields.description: Fields to search. Only title is supported, for issues and merge_requests scopes on Premium and Ultimate tiers.
fields.title: Fields

label_name.description: Label names that every result must have. Accepts up to 30 names for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.
label_name.title: Label Name

num_context_lines.description: Number of context lines around each match. Applies only to advanced and exact code search.
num_context_lines.title: Num Context Lines

order_by.description: Field used to order results. Title ordering is limited by scope and search type.
order_by.title: Order By

per_page.description: Number of search results to return per page (1-100).
per_page.title: Per Page

project_id.description: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.
project_id.title: Project Id

ref.description: Repository branch or tag to search. Valid only for blobs, commits, and wiki_blobs scopes; defaults to the project's default branch.
ref.title: Ref

regex.description: Whether exact code search uses regular expressions. Applies only to exact code search.
regex.title: Regex

scope.description: Project resource type to search. Result fields vary by scope.
scope.title: Scope

search.description: Term to search for in the selected project scope.
search.title: Search

search_type.description: Search backend to use: basic, advanced, or exact code search (zoekt).
search_type.title: Search Type

source_branch.description: Filter by source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.
source_branch.title: Source Branch

state.description: Filter by state for issues, work_items, and merge_requests scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.
state.title: State

target_branch.description: Filter by target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.
target_branch.title: Target Branch

type.description: Work-item types to include. Applies only to the work_items scope.
type.title: Type

name: search_project

next_page.description: Next page number, when another page exists.
next_page.title: Next Page

per_page.description: Number of results requested per page.
per_page.title: Per Page

prev_page.description: Previous page number, when a previous page exists.
prev_page.title: Prev Page

results.description: Scope-dependent GitLab search result objects for this page.
results.title: Results

total.description: Total number of matching results, when supplied by GitLab.
total.title: Total

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages, when supplied by GitLab.
total_pages.title: Total Pages
